interconnect_intra_node_u_reason: (U) TP=1 on a single GPU; there is no inter-GPU link in the serving path, so no intra-node interconnect was exercised and none is declared. Describing the node's NVLink here would describe hardware the run never touched.
interconnect_inter_node_u_reason: (U) single-node campaign only; multi-node scaling not measured
node_exclusivity_u_reason: (U) not captured; the node physically hosts 8 GPUs and this run used exactly 1, but whether the remaining devices were in use during the run was not recorded

notes.cpu_cores: A scheduler allocation, not the machine: the node reports 112 logical cores in total and the cluster QoS grants 12 per GPU, which is what this single-GPU run received. Under this image workload the host decodes and patchifies every request, so the 12 is a capacity input; host sampling during calibration peaked at 11.53 of them.
notes.gpus_per_node: The node hosts 8 H100s; this run was allocated 1. The other 7 are declared for topology, not because they served traffic.
